questions.q: What RMA line status is required before the financial side of a return (the credit memo) can be created?
questions.explain: Once the returned units are received and inspected, the RMA line moves to Awaiting Billing, which unlocks the credit memo.

questions.q: What is the credit memo amount for the 20 damaged units on SO-48217?
Why is the credit memo calculated using $137.75 per unit instead of the $145.00 list price?
options: Because list price is always used for credits
Because the units were defective and priced at zero
Because Harborview requested a different price
Because the credit should reflect the same discounted price the units were actually billed at
questions.explain: Crediting at the originally billed (discounted) price ensures Harborview is credited exactly what they were charged — no more, no less.

questions.q: What is the key difference between an applied credit memo and an on-account credit?
options: They are exactly the same thing
An applied credit memo is tied to and immediately reduces a specific invoice; an on-account credit sits on the account until applied
An on-account credit can only be used for new customers
An applied credit memo can never reduce a balance
questions.explain: An applied credit memo references a specific invoice and reduces its balance right away; an on-account credit is unapplied until later.
